name: Exa MCP Server
what: Exa's official MCP server for web search and page fetching. The hosted server gives web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa by default, with optional advanced search and an Exa Agent tool for multi-step research. MIT licensed.
who: Anyone who wants AI-oriented web search in their agent. It works anonymously with rate limits; sign in or add an API key for higher limits and Exa Agent.

setup.text: Add the hosted server to your MCP client:

setup.code:
claude plugin install exa@claude-plugins-official
codex mcp add exa --url https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp

setup.text: Turn on extra tools by listing them in the URL, for example https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp?tools=web_search_exa,web_fetch_exa,agent_run (this replaces the defaults).

prompts: Search for recent blog posts about agent memory and summarize the main ideas.
Fetch the docs page for this library and tell me how to configure retries.
Find 5 open-source alternatives to Lovable and link their GitHub repos.
